record.field: Job-role groups for the aquarium shop (Cashier, Fish Staff, Manager, Administrator) - assign exactly one of these four to a real staff user.

Gate group for field-level access to purchase-cost and profit figures (stock.lot cost/profit fields, purchase order line unit cost, product standard cost). Not meant to be assigned directly - it is implied by Aquarium Manager and Aquarium Administrator.

POS billing, full. Does NOT imply stock.group_stock_user (that grants write access to stock operations) - inventory visibility for this role is intentionally read-only, granted via the explicit ir.rule / access below rather than a broad built-in group. No purchase, no fish management (see ir.rule deny in aquarium_field_security.xml), no accounting, no settings.

stock.group_stock_user (not stock.group_stock_manager) is the "inventory limited" grant - can process transfers/pickings but not configure warehouses or approve everything an Inventory Administrator could. stock.group_production_lot + stock.group_stock_multi_locations are needed for fish batches (lots) and multi-tank (multi-location) visibility. Full CRUD on the fish-specific models themselves (species, batches, mortality, transfers) already comes from aquarium_fish_management's own ir.model.access.csv, most of which is granted to base.group_user (any internal user) or stock.group_stock_manager - see the README's "known gap" note for the one place that needed an explicit ir.rule instead (Cashier must NOT get fish-management write access it would otherwise inherit purely by being an internal user). No POS group, no purchase group, no accounting group, no settings.

field.name: implied_ids
field.eval: [ (4, ref('group_aquarium_cashier')), (4, ref('group_aquarium_fish_staff')), (4, ref('stock.group_stock_manager')), (4, ref('purchase.group_purchase_user')), (4, ref('account.group_account_invoice')), (4, ref('group_aquarium_financial_data')), ]

record.field: Implies Cashier + Fish Staff (so a Manager can do everything either of those roles can) plus stock.group_stock_manager (full inventory incl. config - upgrades Fish Staff's "limited" stock.group_stock_user to full), purchase.group_purchase_user (full purchasing - create/confirm POs), and account.group_account_invoice ("Billing" - can create/post invoices, i.e. handle expenses at the transactional level). Deliberately does NOT imply account.group_account_manager ("Billing Administrator" - that's what unlocks the OCA P&L/Balance Sheet/Trial Balance reports installed on this instance) or base.group_system (Settings) - that is the "limited expenses & profit reports, no settings" part of the spec. group_aquarium_financial_data grants read access to the purchase-cost/ profit *fields* themselves (see aquarium_field_security.xml) - "limited" profit reporting means Manager can see the numbers on a fish batch record but not run the full accounting reports, not that the fields are hidden from them entirely.

Implies Manager (so gets everything Manager, Fish Staff and Cashier get) plus base.group_system (Settings, technical features, module install, user/group management), account.group_account_manager (full accounting incl. the OCA P&L/Balance Sheet/Trial Balance reports), purchase.group_purchase_manager (purchase configuration) and point_of_sale.group_pos_manager (POS configuration, all sessions). This is the "Administrator/Owner" role - full access to everything in the matrix. group_aquarium_financial_data comes along transitively via Manager.
